scenarios.title: Janitor deletes verify branches of done, rejected and unknown slices under the default format
scenarios.notes: Risk: deleting a branch the loop needs. Try done, rejected, unknown, in_progress, todo and no-status ids. Only the first three verify branches go; run, attempt, slice, milestone, e2e and state branches stay.

scenarios.title: Janitor keeps every non-verify kind and unparseable names
scenarios.notes: Inputs: sdlc/run-1, sdlc/S-004-attempt-1, sdlc/S-004-attempt-1-v0-http-api-0 (verify-shaped, id ends in -attempt-N, must stay), sdlc/M-1, sdlc/M-1-e2e, sdlc/state-<ts>, sdlc/-v1, sdlc/S-001-v1, nested names, unicode and whitespace names. Nothing may be deleted.

scenarios.title: Janitor sweeps verify branches under a custom format and spares run and attempt branches
scenarios.notes: Config branchFormat feature/sdlc/{name}. Check removedBranches and remaining refs. Also try prefix collisions such as a branch whose name embeds another format.

scenarios.title: Janitor leaves old-format verify branches when the format is derived
scenarios.notes: Config feature/sdlc/{name}; sdlc/S-001-v0-http-api-0 with S-001 done must stay. parse of sdlc/S-001 gives null and list --kind slice omits it.

scenarios.title: Janitor resolves lowercased ids through the ledger
scenarios.notes: Format feature/p-1-{name:lower}. s-001 resolves to S-001 (done, removed); s-002 todo stays; s-999 unknown removed; feature/p-1-run-1 stays. Try mixed-case ledger ids.

scenarios.title: Janitor reports an unusable format or ledger as a note and deletes nothing
scenarios.notes: Format without placeholder, malformed config, missing or unreadable ledger, non-object JSON. Exit 0, notes name the cause, no branch removed, scratch reaping and worktree prune still run.

scenarios.title: Janitor source holds no V_BRANCH or V_ID and loads the format through branches.load_format
scenarios.notes: Read janitor.py text; check that docstring and imports are consistent and py_compile passes.

tools.purpose: run janitor.py in scratch git repos and record exit code, notes and tree diff
hostile branch names and format strings
call branches.parse and load_format with generated formats and names

riskReason: The janitor deletes git branches, and a wrong parse can delete work the loop needs.
notes: Profiles are tagged most important first: cli, security, contract. No numeric limits in the spec, so no limits profile.
